thread_text:
sam: Quick sync 30fter standup 55 55 prepping the internal announce & RN for v2.3.1. Change window Fri 23:00 UTC. Need: short ops checklist, exact pin header, deploybot commands, and a one-paragraph internal blurb. Who can own the blast?

nina: I can own the blast. I'll assemble the RN bullets and the short blurb. Will post a draft link here in ~45m.

lee: Canary plan proposal: 15% @ 20m, 40% @ 20m, 100% @ 20m. Health gates: error_rate > 1.5% over 5m OR p95 latency delta > 80ms => pause + rollback. OOM spike = immediate pause.

mike: Add a fail-open note for Dedicated customers: we won't automatically flip Dedicated traffic. Include header they must set: `x-rw-runtime: rif-runtime@3c7f`. We'll offer a migration window.

tanya: Draft blurb idea: "v2.3.1: KV-cache fixes, streaming token efficiency improvements (~10% cost), and runtime patch for quant stability." Short, plain.

deploybot: deploy scheduled: v2.3.1 canary start=2024-11-03T23:00:00Z. Suggested command: `/deploy v2.3.1 --canary=15% --stages=40%,100% --stage-duration=20m`

nina: Nice. I'll include the exact deploybot commands in the RN so oncall can copy/paste. Also adding the console pin steps for Dedicated.

sam: Please include an explicit fallback runtime in the RN (name+how to set). If runtime pin fails, traffic should retry on `rif-quant-v2`.

lee: Short rollback runbook to paste into RN: 1) `/deploybot pause --deploy-id {{id}}` 2) `/deploybot rollback --to v2.3.0` 3) `curl -H "x-rw-runtime: rif-runtime@3c7f" https://api.redwood.ai/health` 4) notify #eng-oncall + CSMs. Keep commands minimal.

mike: Also include an observability quick-check: 
`errors_rate = query("sum(rate(runtime_errors[5m])) by (env)")`
`lat_p95 = query("histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le))")`
So oncall knows where to look.

opsbot: Registered automation triggers for v2.3.1: error_rate > 1.5% (5m), p95_delta > 80ms (5m), oom_count > 0 (2m). Auto-rollback if two conditions fire.

nina: Draft posted: https://rwd.internal/releases/drafts/v2.3.1-rn-draft 5 please review. I'll plan internal announce at 22:40 UTC (20m before window) unless objections.

tanya: Suggest we include a 'how we tested' bullet: staging smoke (1000 streaming tokens/min for 15m), GPU memory profile checks, and quant regression evals. Small note for SRE to validate.

sam: Thx. Add a tiny section for Legal: no customer-facing note until we confirm rollout. Also reminder: avoid customer email between 00:00-06:00 UTC.

lee: Oncall coverage: I'll be primary, Juan covering handoff (if needed). Add both in the RN.

mike: Can we add the exact header snippet for customers using SDKs? e.g. `client.setHeader("x-rw-runtime","rif-runtime@3c7f")`. I'll paste client examples in the RN.

nina: Done. I added SDK snippet + Dedicated header note. Also added the ops checklist at top with copy/paste commands.

sam: Run a quick staging smoke now and report back in 15m. If green, I'll give :thumbsup: and Nina can send blast.

deploybot: Reminder: deploybot blackout rules active. Manual override required for blackouts.

opsbot: Saved runbook excerpt: 
```bash
# Pause deploy
/deploybot pause --id {{deploy_id}}
# Rollback to v2.3.0
/deploybot rollback --to v2.3.0
# Pin runtime header back if needed
curl -X POST https://console.internal/api/pins -d '{"runtime":"rif-runtime@3c7f"}'
```

tanya: LGTM. Minor copy edit on the internal blurb (made it more concise).

nina: Updated draft with Tanya's edit. Final pass at 22:35 UTC then I'll post at 22:40 UTC.

sam: Staging smoke: memory and token-cost checks look good. No OOMs. :thumbsup:

nina: Posting internal announce now (22:40 UTC). Will include link to RN, rollback runbook, deploybot commands, and oncall names.

deploybot: Canary kicking off (15%) 5 monitoring hooks enabled. Good luck everyone! :rocket:
